question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

9, 35, 91, 189, 341, ?
solution:
**Logic :** Triple addition pattern is followed by common difference of 12.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03274588f3dfa761621eb172603e4b520e415fd575c44ca10f142d176a27113c.png]
